adHighCpu.description: Triggers high cpu load in the ad service

adManualGc.description: Triggers full manual garbage collections in the ad service

cartFailure.description: Fail cart service n% of the time

cartMetricCardinalityOverflow.description: Adds the current trace ID to demo.cart.get_cart.latency to trigger SDK metric cardinality overflow. Backported from upstream main (commit a5c52c7).

emitRawPii.description: Emit raw PII attributes (user.email, demo.payment.card_number, demo.payment.card_cvv) from checkout and payment for the collector redaction example. Not a failure scenario -- controls PII emission, independent of collector-side redaction which always runs.

failedReadinessProbe.description: readiness probe failure for cart service

imageSlowLoad.description: slow loading images in the frontend

kafkaConsumerDead.description: fraud-detection leaves the orders consumer group (unsubscribes and stops polling) while checkout keeps producing, so the group empties (members -> 0) and lag climbs against a zero-member group. Backported from upstream main (commit 258466e).

kafkaQueueProblems.description: Overloads Kafka queue while simultaneously introducing a consumer side delay leading to a lag spike

loadGeneratorFloodHomepage.description: Flood the frontend with a large amount of requests.

paymentFailure.description: Fail payment service charge requests n%

productCatalogFailure.description: Fail product catalog service on a specific product

productCatalogLockContention.description: Trigger lock contention on the product catalog database
